turns.text: The previous story examined DENDRAL. Now the camera turns to XCON-R1 and a new question along the same timeline: If we take XCON-R1 apart, which idea truly changed the direction of research?
Computer systems were sold as many interacting components, and human configuration errors could delay or break orders.
That sounds like a promising direction. What mechanism actually makes it work?

Production rules matched facts in working memory, fired actions, and incrementally built a valid hardware configuration. The key mechanism is OPS5 production-rule configuration, which links the source material to the visible demo behavior.

Experts generally treat XCON/R1 as a landmark industrial expert system and a proof that knowledge engineering could deliver business value. Its long-term legacy is the case-study role it plays in expert-system maintenance, rule management, and applied AI deployment.
Seen alongside DENDRAL, XCON-R1 reveals how the same technical question can echo across different eras.
